title: The Rockies: Guernsey is where the trains change, on one page
dek: Guernsey is where northern and western barrels change trains. Bakken crude comes south on Butte, Powder River crude comes down from Casper, DJ crude comes north to the same junction, and what leaves Guernsey leaves as Cushing barrels on Pony Express or Midwest barrels on Platte.
